guidance: So should we expect ARPP growth to pick up in coming years from '28 onwards?
capex: Including Ghaziabad, our expansion pipeline comprises of 6 new greenfield hospitals, supporting our ambition to double our bed capacity over time.
Overall, our census bed capacity increased to 3,115 in Q2 FY27 from 2,658 beds in Q2 FY26, a growth of 17%.
risks: So we don't see any reason why there should be any challenges in any of the hospitals in Cluster 2, but we don't look at it only on a quarter -to-quarter basis to say what will the margin be this quarter or that quarter.
We may see some slowdown or stoppage of construction activity with the pollution -linked norms for construction activity that may impact over the next 1 or 2 months.
focus: Our focus is not simply on adding capacity, but on taking the Medanta model of high -quality, advanced healthcare to more geographies, particularly those where access to comprehensive specialized care remains limited.
And as we expand, we will remain focused on disciplined execution, maintaining the highest standard of care and building institutions that earn the trust of the communities they serve.
What happens next quarter or Q4, I think this we worry less about, but more focused on driving long-term sustainability.

about: Global Health Limited operates a network of multi-specialty tertiary and quaternary care hospitals under the Medanta brand, primarily across North and East India. The company specialises in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, digestive and hepatobiliary sciences, orthopaedics, organ transplantation, kidney and urology, and other complex medical procedures.
